propositions: Implement a new `rebar metrics` READ subcommand that accepts `--since`, `--until`, and `--output json|text` arguments to render the full metric registry over a date range without date bucketing.

Wire the `metrics` command via an explicit `if sub == 'metrics':` dispatch arm in `_dispatch()` (not a frozenset route) that imports `rebar._commands.metrics` and ensures the store is initialized first.

The command must import `rebar.metrics` (the package, not just the registry module) to trigger reader registration side-effects that populate `REGISTRY`, then evaluate every `MetricSpec` via `registry.evaluate(spec, context)` where context carries repo_root, since, and until.

Wrap each metric evaluation in try-except to render failures as unavailable rather than crashing the command; compose output from both spec.lens and evaluate result (value/source/confidence or reason/accruing_since).

Output formats: JSON (machine contract) includes `since`, `until`, and a `metrics` map with every registered id as either a value object or an unavailable object; `--output text` is a human summary with one line per metric in registry order.

Add `'metrics'` to the `individual` frozenset in `test_help_overview_coverage.py`, regenerate CLI help snapshots and `docs/cli-reference.md`, and verify the portability guard asserts no `rebar.metrics.adapters` import in `metrics.py`.
